question: India’s oldest and largest independent, non-profit economic policy research institute, NCAER (National Council of Applied Economic Research), was established in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1956.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Started in 1956,** NCAER is India's oldest and biggest independent, non-profit, economic policy research institute.**
 
• **National Council of Applied Economic Research** board-run body to give help to both** the government and the private sector in empirical economic research.**
 
• The** first ruling Body of NCAER **comprised all Economics Ministers and main lights of the private sector, like **C. D. Deshmukh, J. R. D. Tata, John Matthai.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• National Council of Applied Economic Research is** India's oldest and biggest economic foundation**.
 
• It is also one of a handful of foundations in the world that merge rigorous analysis and policy outreach with **deep data collection capabilities, mainly for large scale household surveys.​ **
